name: Salome (Jesus' aunt?, Wife of Zebedee)
title: Faithful Follower of Jesus
summary: Salome was the wife of the fisherman Zebedee and mother of the apostles James and John. She was one of the women who followed Jesus and served him throughout his earthly ministry, and she was present both at the crucifixion and at the empty tomb on Easter morning.

keyEvents.title: Requests Seats of Honor for Her Sons
keyEvents.description: Salome came to Jesus with her sons and asked that they be allowed to sit at his right and left hand in his kingdom. Jesus responded by teaching about the spirit of service.

keyEvents.title: Served Jesus in Galilee
keyEvents.description: Salome was among the women who followed Jesus from Galilee and served him with what they had.

keyEvents.title: Witness to the Crucifixion
keyEvents.description: Salome stood with other women and watched as Jesus was crucified at Golgotha. She remained faithful even in this dark hour.

keyEvents.title: At the Tomb on Easter Morning
keyEvents.description: Early in the morning on the first day of the week, Salome came with Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, to the tomb with fragrant oils to anoint Jesus' body.
